budgets.field: per-session pending persisted input rows and bytes

budgets.phase: daemon child spawn through Happy identity registration or exact restored-provider registration

lifecycleTransitions.from: one validated persisted Server row held in the per-session FIFO
lifecycleTransitions.to: the registered input handler synchronously takes ownership of the row, a digest-bound visibility receipt is emitted on the existing encrypted message stream, and the in-memory anchor advances
lifecycleTransitions.creator: ApiSessionClient Socket update or bounded recovery query
lifecycleTransitions.advancer: ApiSessionClient synchronous drain callback followed by non-blocking receipt emission
lifecycleTransitions.consumer: the existing provider queue or local command handler; the receipt is never recovery-completion authority

lifecycleTransitions.from: a persisted restore or reconnect tail not loaded because its bounded query had a retryable transport failure
lifecycleTransitions.to: the same per-session recovery owner retries with bounded exponential delay until one complete snapshot is loaded, a deterministic snapshot rejection occurs, or the session stops
lifecycleTransitions.creator: completeProviderInputReady or a live Socket reconnect
lifecycleTransitions.consumer: ApiSessionClient persisted-input FIFO; live Socket input remains independently available

lifecycleTransitions.from: daemon child without an input consumer

lifecycleTransitions.creator: Happy CLI daemon child spawn
